build_MaxIoUAssigner: build a MaxIoUAssigner instance with pos_iou_thr and neg_iou_thr thresholds for bounding box assignment
assign_bboxes_to_gts: assign ground truth bounding boxes to proposal bboxes using MaxIoUAssigner assign method with IoU thresholds
assign_wrt_overlaps: assign bounding boxes to ground truth based on precomputed overlap matrix using assign_wrt_overlaps method
review_MaxIoUAssigner_init: review the MaxIoUAssigner constructor to understand IoU threshold parameters and low quality matching options
test_MaxIoUAssigner_assign: test the MaxIoUAssigner assign method with sample bboxes and ground truth boxes to verify correct assignment
